import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

class Edge {
    int from, to;
    double length;
    Edge(int f, int t, double l) {
        this.from = f;
        this.to = t;
        this.length = l;
    }
}

class Node {
    List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
}

class Graph {
    List<Node> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();

    Graph(int n_nodes, int n_edges) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n_nodes; i++) {
            nodes.add(new Node());
        }
        // edges list is initialized empty
    }

    void add_edge(int from, int to, double length) {
        edges.add(new Edge(from, to, length));
        nodes.get(from).out.add(edges.size() - 1);
    }

    List<Integer> find_path(int source, int sink, double[] flow, double[] path_cap) {
        PriorityQueue<int[]> q = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Double.compare(b[0], a[0]));
        double[] capacity = new double[nodes.size()];
        int[] pred = new int[nodes.size()];
        Arrays.fill(pred, -1);
        Arrays.fill(capacity, 0);
        capacity[source] = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        q.offer(new int[]{(int)capacity[source], source});

        while (!q.isEmpty() && capacity[sink] == 0) {
            int[] top = q.poll();
            double cap = top[0];
            int n = top[1];

            for (int e_idx : nodes.get(n).out) {
                Edge e = edges.get(e_idx);
                double e_cap = e.length - flow[e_idx];
                if (e_cap > 0 && Math.min(cap, e_cap) > capacity[e.to]) {
                    // Remove old entry if exists
                    // Since Java PriorityQueue doesn't support decrease-key, we can add duplicates
                    capacity[e.to] = Math.min(cap, e_cap);
                    q.offer(new int[]{(int)capacity[e.to], e.to});
                    pred[e.to] = e_idx;
                }
            }
        }

        path_cap[0] = capacity[sink];
        List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int e_idx = pred[sink]; e_idx != -1; e_idx = pred[edges.get(e_idx).from]) {
            path.add(e_idx);
        }
        return path;
    }

    double max_flow(int source, int sink) {
        Graph residual = new Graph(nodes.size(), 2 * edges.size());
        double[] flow = new double[2 * edges.size()];
        double total_flow = 0;
        double[] path_cap = new double[1];

        for (Edge e : edges) {
            residual.add_edge(e.from, e.to, e.length);
            residual.add_edge(e.to, e.from, 0);
        }

        List<Integer> path = residual.find_path(source, sink, flow, path_cap);
        while (path_cap[0] > 0) {
            for (int e_idx : path) {
                int rev_idx = (e_idx % 2 == 0) ? e_idx + 1 : e_idx - 1;
                flow[e_idx] += path_cap[0];
                flow[rev_idx] -= path_cap[0];
            }
            path = residual.find_path(source, sink, flow, path_cap);
        }

        for (int e_idx : residual.nodes.get(source).out) {
            total_flow += flow[e_idx];
        }
        return total_flow;
    }

    void print_all() {
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes.size(); i++) {
            System.out.print("Node " + i + " connects to: ");
            for (int e_idx : nodes.get(i).out) {
                System.out.print(e_idx + " ");
            }
            System.out.println();
        }
    }
}

class Room {
    int i, j;
    boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
    boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
    int scientists, capsules;

    Room() {
        Arrays.fill(infected, false);
        Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
        scientists = 0;
        capsules = 0;
    }

    int get_node_id(int timestamp, int n) {
        return 2 + i + n * j + (n * n) * timestamp;
    }

    void set_reactor() {
        Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
    }

    void set_infected(int timestamp) {
        if (accessible[timestamp]) {
            accessible[timestamp] = false;
            infected[timestamp] = true;
        }
    }

    void spread_infection(int timestamp, int n, Room[][] floorplan) {
        if (infected[timestamp]) {
            set_infected(timestamp + 1);
            if (i > 0) floorplan[i - 1][j].set_infected(timestamp + 1);
            if (i < n - 1) floorplan[i + 1][j].set_infected(timestamp + 1);
            if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j - 1].set_infected(timestamp + 1);
            if (j < n - 1) floorplan[i][j + 1].set_infected(timestamp + 1);
        }
    }
}

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static Room[][] floorplan;

    public static String id_to_string(int id) {
        if (id == 0) return "source";
        if (id == 1) return "sink";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        int row = (id - 2) % n;
        int col = ((id - 2 - row) % (n * n)) / n;
        int timestamp = (id - 2 - row - col * n) / (n * n);
        sb.append("(").append(row).append(",").append(col).append(",").append(timestamp).append(")");
        return sb.toString();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        floorplan = new Room[n][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (floorplan[i][j] == null) floorplan[i][j] = new Room();
                floorplan[i][j].i = i;
                floorplan[i][j].j = j;
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    floorplan[i][j].set_reactor();
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].set_infected(0);
                } else {
                    floorplan[i][j].scientists = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].capsules = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int c = 0; c <= t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (c < t) {
                        floorplan[i][j].spread_infection(c, n, floorplan);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int total_nodes = n * n * (t + 1) + 2;
        Graph g = new Graph(total_nodes, 100 * 4 * 60);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Room room = floorplan[i][j];
                if (room.scientists > 0) {
                    g.add_edge(0, room.get_node_id(0, n), room.scientists);
                }
                if (room.capsules > 0) {
                    g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(t, n), 1, room.capsules);
                }
                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0) {
                        g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c, n), room.get_node_id(t, n), 1000);
                    }
                    if (room.accessible[c]) {
                        if (i > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i - 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c, n), other.get_node_id(c + 1, n), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (i < n - 1) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i + 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c, n), other.get_node_id(c + 1, n), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (j > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j - 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c, n), other.get_node_id(c + 1, n), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (j < n - 1) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j + 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c, n), other.get_node_id(c + 1, n), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println((int)g.max_flow(0, 1));
    }
}
